name: temp-core-designer-check
description: Designer-level PVT check of design/temp_core.sch: PTAT/CTAT transfer and output headroom, systematic temperature error, supply sensitivity, Iq, disabled-state draw, pad-load sensitivity and trim-ladder range/LSB.
claim: spec/target-spec.md#temp-vt-transfer -- design-intent slope and output range for the PTAT/CTAT pads, the row target-spec.md tags [TBD-#9] and this issue owns. Also substantiates, at the systematic level only: #temp-accuracy-untrimmed (+/-3 C), #temp-supply-sensitivity (<=0.5 C/V, i.e. <=0.33 C over the +/-10 % window), #temp-iq (<20 uA) and #temp-trim-strategy (1-point 25 C gain trim -- range and LSB measured here). Deterministic corners only: design.ngspice sets sw_stat_mismatch=0, so this bounds the SYSTEMATIC error and cannot see the mismatch share the [3sigma] rows require -- that is issue #15's Monte Carlo job, and target-spec.md marks those rows 'conditional #15' for exactly this reason. Published measured values ([TBD-#13]) and full spec-row coverage remain issue #13's.

vptat.description: PTAT output over -40..125 C; the spread floor proves .temp actually applied (a flat PTAT output is broken, not perfect)

vctat.description: CTAT output = VEB of XQ1; falls ~1.86 mV/C

terr_untrim_c.description: spec/target-spec.md#temp-accuracy-untrimmed. Untrimmed temperature error against the declared nominal transfer constant K0 = 4.308842 mV/K (tt, 25 C). Deterministic corners only -- the +/-3 C row is a [3sigma] figure that also has to absorb mismatch, which this record cannot see.

terr_supply_c.description: spec/target-spec.md#temp-supply-sensitivity: <=0.5 C/V, i.e. <=0.33 C across the +/-10 % window. Measured as the difference between the DUT on this point's rail and an identical DUT on vdd_nom, so it is a true per-point number and reads exactly 0 at the nominal rail

vout_margin_v.description: spec/target-spec.md#temp-vt-transfer headroom bound [P#1]: 0.2 V <= V(out) <= VDD - 0.2 V at every corner, for BOTH pads. This measurement is the worst of the four margins, so a single number >= 0 is the whole bound

iq_ua.description: spec/target-spec.md#temp-iq (<20 uA). Conservative against the row as written: target-spec.md §5 rule 1 charges shared-bias-core current that must be live before POR to #por-iq, but this number includes the whole 0.5 uA IBIAS reference pushed into the pin

iq_dis_ua.description: EN low (pre-POR): the cell's own draw from its VDD pin must be negligible

vptat_dis_mv.description: EN low: PTAT pad held at VSS, not floating

vctat_dis_mv.description: EN low: CTAT pad held at VSS, not floating

aoffs_uv.description: residual V(NA)-V(NB): the amplifier's SYSTEMATIC input offset. 1 mV here costs 5.58 C untrimmed, so it has to stay in the tens of uV by design; the random share is #15's.

vnd_mv.description: startup-kick node: high only while the core is dead, so a live core must show it collapsed

mp3_hdr_v.description: VDD - V(M3D): headroom left for the PTAT leg's cascode stack at the worst (hot, low-rail) corner

rtrim_lsb_pct.description: one trim LSB as a fraction of R2 (design 0.25 %, reduced by switch Ron)

rtrim_range_pct.description: full trim range (design 15.75 %, i.e. +/-7.9 % about the nominal code) -- must cover a +/-4 mV amplifier offset

load10m_err_pct.description: gain error from a 10 Mohm pad load. Not a pass/fail on the design -- it is the measured cost of having no output buffer (DR-005's temp_buffer cell), and the reason the pad spec is Rload >= 1 Gohm.
